title: b12065: kv-cache : never return 0 kv_rows for sequences without cells (#31570)
description: A cache that shares the cells of another one (f.ex. the gemma4 assistant) can build a graph before its sequences have any cells, f.ex. at the server warmup. get_n_kv_rows() then returned 0, which means that kv_rows are not used, so the graph fell back to the dense KQ mask and the scheduler re-planned for it. Later graphs with larger masks then aborted with GGML_SCHED_DEBUG_REALLOC=1.

description: hexagon: tiled hvx permute ( #31446 ) hexagon: add tiled HVX transpose path for permuted CONT/CPY Permuted copies where dst dim 0 is strided in src, but some other src dim is contiguous, used to fall back to HTP_COPY_KERNEL_RESHAPE. That issues one DMA descriptor per element.
